registry_source_conditions.interpretation: These are source requirements, not fulfilled migration or theorem counts.

destination_basis: HTT_ALL_OBLIGATIONS_20261011_PACKAGE.zip: START.json, tasks/S02.json, UPPER_BACKLOG_COVERAGE.json, and selected U-R9/R190/R193/R194/R195 task cards. The family crosswalk is PARTIAL_REMAINDER and thematic, not an exact producer certificate.

kill_switches: no scalar anchor stress as nonlinearity, FLRW distance, or FLRW converse
no observer boost as geometric departure
no generic chart as complete ring
profile likelihood is not sampling law
Doob bound is conditional conservative, not exact calibration
local rank is not physical tilt identification
registry and executable contract must match
do not relax stochastic fast-oracle failure
proposal does not change frozen legacy status
claim_withholding: nonidentical orbit counterpair with equal catalogue withholds complete classifier
no held-out improvement withholds empirical significance
mostly [0,1] Pi envelope withholds source-information claim
mask variation dominating depth withholds depth-coherence claim
tangent overlap or small s_min yields WEAKLY_IDENTIFIED/SUM_ONLY
degenerate undercoverage withholds inference pending tangent-cone/second-order method
finite invariant coordinates do not close multiplicity
no admitted data/joint covariance means no real-data pilot

semantic_invariants: x_C is a signed projection with cancellation preserved; anchor stress is a distinct nonnegative object
Q is policy/acceptance-body normalized score, not information gain
Pi is conditional exceedance under an identified conditioning law/envelope, not truth probability
F is certified occupancy only for sign-clean admissible ceiling and declared image/measure; otherwise refuse or use distinct support/pushforward quantities
G_F is a calibrated depth-gap under eligible F paths, not global tilt evidence
MIO produces family-independent diagnostics and null surfaces; HTT owns model-dependent likelihood/posterior/evidence
external transfer and synthetic/native proxies do not establish native solver output
